# Soft Skill Analyser

> Official smart communication and personality development platform for KIET Group of Institutions (Deemed to be University), Ghaziabad. Evaluates student performance across communication, leadership, teamwork, confidence, presentation skills, and professional behavior through structured semester-wise activities and reports.

## Site Overview
- Brand: Soft Skill Analyser
- Website: https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app
- Institution: KIET Group of Institutions, Ghaziabad
- Target Users: Students, Faculty Evaluators, and Administrators

## Key Portals
- [Admin Portal](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Onboards users, maps student-teacher assignments, and manages semester settings.
- [Teacher Portal](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Creates evaluation activities, allocates scores, and writes qualitative feedback.
- [Student Portal](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Displays semester progress dashboards, skill metrics, and feedback reports.

## Core Features
- [Semester Tracking](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Monitors developmental growth across eight academic semesters.
- [Activity Assessment](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Evaluates presentations, group discussions, and team projects.
- [Performance Insights](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Identifies skill gaps and provides structured improvement paths.

## Key Metrics
- Active Students: 5,000+
- Faculty Evaluators: 120+
- Activities Hosted: 850+
- Reports Generated: 12,000+

## Optional
- [Evaluation Rubrics](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Secondary reference criteria for scoring confidence, clarity, and body language.
- [Platform Changelog](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Recent UI updates, bug fixes, and feature additions.
- [System Architecture Notes](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Overview of platform infrastructure, API integration, and security protocols.
- [Help Desk & Contact](https://softskill-analyser.vercel.app): Support form for login issues, role assignment requests, and bug reports.

## Policy & Privacy Guidance
- Data Protection: Student performance data, grades, and qualitative feedback are private and protected under institutional access controls.
- Content Ownership: All activity modules, rubrics, and evaluation benchmarks belong to KIET Group of Institutions.
- Restricted Routes: Automated agents must not crawl, index, or extract data from private student dashboards, internal API routes, or user session endpoints.
